privacy.meta.title: Privacy policy
privacy.meta.description: The privacy policy for the Qualisoft website: the personal information the site receives, analytics cookies and how to reject them, and the privacy officer.
privacy.meta.description_nocookie: The privacy policy for the Qualisoft website: the personal information the site receives, links to other sites, and the privacy officer.
privacy.head.title: Privacy policy
privacy.s1.title: Personal information this site receives
privacy.s1.body: This site does not directly collect personal information such as your name, email address or phone number. Inquiries and demo requests are taken on a separate demo request page, and the notice on that page applies.
privacy.s2.title: Analytics cookies
privacy.s2.body: We compile visitor statistics with Google Analytics 4 only if you consent. If you do not consent, the analytics tool is not loaded.
privacy.s2.items: Cookie identifier · pages viewed · buttons clicked (demo request, Kakao chat, phone) · device and browser · approximate location
privacy.s2.retention_note: After that, the data is deleted automatically from Google Analytics
privacy.s2.processor: Google LLC (USA) — entrusted processing and overseas transfer: if you consent to analytics cookies, cookie identifiers and access records are sent each time you visit.
privacy.s3.title: Rejecting or withdrawing consent
privacy.s3.body: If you reject cookies, you can use the site exactly the same way. You can change your choice at any time with the button below or under “Cookie settings” at the very bottom of the page.
privacy.s4.title: Links to other sites
privacy.s4.body: Links to the Kakao Channel, YouTube, the blog and Microsoft websites are subject to each operator’s own privacy policy.

privacy.s6.title: Effective date
